name: fpl-draft
description: League-aware Draft decisions, daily reports and Google Sheets learning with a concise Notion dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: League-aware waivers, injuries and team selection.
interface.longDescription: Manage a closed-market Premier League Fantasy Draft league using live ownership, available players, fixtures, injury-return evidence and waiver priority. FPL Draft Daily Briefing handles daily reports and spoiler-free Thrillr ratings using the main FPL Draft skill.
defaultPrompt: Review my FPL Draft squad and available players.
Find injury-return waiver targets in my league.
Check my proposed waivers and rank the alternatives.
Use $fpl-draft-daily-briefing to run my FPL Draft Daily Briefing.
